content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends specific tests for screening and diagnosing type 2 diabetes in youth. These include measuring fasting plasma glucose levels or conducting a 75-gram oral glucose tolerance test. Hemoglobin A1C testing is considered a secondary method to identify prediabetes or diabetes. Additionally, for children or adolescents diagnosed with type 2 diabetes who also have obesity, it is recommended to screen for pancreatic autoantibodies. This is done to exclude the possibility of autoimmune type 1 diabetes.
